rules.sentence: For patients with medication (beta-blocker, calcium channel blocker, or disopyramide) refractory symptoms and suitable anatomy, alcohol septal ablation is an established cardiac intervention.
This percutaneous procedure was first described in 1995 as an alternative therapy to surgical myomectomy for left ventricular outflow tract obstruction in patients with HCM.
